scheme_name: Scheme For Award Of Financial Assistance For Education To The Wards Of Beedi/Cine/IOMC/LSDM Workers – Pre & Post-Matric
other_conditions: Applicant must be a child of a Beedi, Mine (IOMC/LSDM), or Cine worker (including Contract/Gharkhata workers) with at least six months of service
Applicant must have passed the last qualifying examination on the first attempt (students promoted to the next class are also eligible)
Applicant must have regular admission in a recognized institution in India for any general or technical course, including medical, engineering, and agricultural studies
Applicant must not be receiving any other scholarship or stipend from any source
Applicant must have a separate bank account; if using a joint account, the scholar’s name must be the first on the account
Each child of the same worker must provide a separate bank account number

Family income of the worker must not exceed the monthly limits specified: ₹10,000 per month for Beedi workers; ₹10,000 per month for supervisory/managerial mine workers; ₹8,000 per month (or ₹1,00,000 lump‑sum) for Cine workers
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹1,000 to ₹25,000 per student per annum, varying by class and course of study
